subject: Permanent G-Zone Residential Parking Implementation
overview: The Medford Traffic Commission voted to make the G-Zone residential parking program permanent and established a permanent no-left-turn at Emerson Street. The commission denied multiple commercial vehicle parking variances based on a city ordinance prohibiting overnight commercial parking on public streets.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the January 2025 Traffic Commission meetings.

items.title: 2025-11: Visitor Pass Variance for Tesla Avenue
items.summary: Tabled the request for visitor passes for 14 Winthrop Street because the petitioner was not present to discuss the corner lot variance.

items.title: 2025-12: Parking Variance for Harvard Street
items.summary: Withdrawn by the petitioner's representative with the understanding that corner lot residents are eligible for GLX zone permits without special commission approval.

items.title: 2025-13: Parking Variance for Honeywell Avenue
items.summary: Denied the variance for a resident of 305 Riverside Avenue because unrestricted parking is available within 500 feet on Spring Street.

items.title: 2025-14: No Parking on Park Street at Park Street Court
items.summary: Approved signing a 20-to-30-foot no-parking zone at the corner to improve sightlines where vehicles currently block views of oncoming traffic.

items.title: 2025-15: Salem Street Lot Business Parking Designation
items.summary: Placed the item on file after determining the commission lacks jurisdiction over the lot, which is owned by Verizon/National Grid and managed via a handshake agreement.

items.title: 2025-16: Parking Meter Changes at 36 Salem Street
items.summary: Approved changing three parking spaces to two-hour metered parking and authorized adding an additional space if engineering confirms the curb capacity.

items.title: 2025-19: Parking Variance for 23 Burgett Avenue
items.summary: Denied a parking variance for a commercial vehicle with out-of-state plates because it violates a 2002 city ordinance prohibiting overnight commercial parking.

items.title: 2025-17: Clippership Lot Waste Storage Agreement
items.summary: Approved an agreement to formalize dumpster placement in the public lot to accommodate recycling for the Ebisuya Market and remove waste piles from the sidewalk.

items.title: 2025-20: Parking Variance for 72 Sharon Street
items.summary: Denied the request for a commercial vehicle parking variance, citing the city ordinance and a lack of off-street parking options at the residence.

items.title: 2021-59: Handicapped Signs on Arlington Street
items.summary: Approved a second handicapped parking space for the West Bedford Community Center to support increased programming and aging residents.

items.title: 2025-18: No Parking on Fulton Spring Road
items.summary: Approved a 50-foot no-parking restriction on the south side of the street near Fulton Street to ensure school buses can make safe turns.

items.title: 2025-21: High Street Crosswalk Daylighting
items.summary: Approved restricting parking near crosswalks at Boynton Road and Powderhouse Road to improve pedestrian safety following a recent accident.

items.title: 2023-47: No Left Turn from Emerson Street to Main Street
items.summary: Approved making the existing no-left-turn restriction permanent following a trial period that significantly reduced traffic accidents at the intersection.

items.title: 2024-37: G-Zone Resident Parking Pilot Review
items.summary: Approved the permanent implementation of the G-Zone parking program after the pilot phase showed zero formal complaints and successful enforcement.
